args.body:
Hi Alice,

I found your email about the resume template. I was able to access the resume templates website (www.resume-templates.com) and see the download links, but I'm encountering some restrictions when trying to download the actual template files from the portal site.

The website has two parts to the download:
1. Resume Template (PDF) - link: https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template.pdf
2. Resume Template Part 2 - link: https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template_part2.pdf

However, the download attempts are being blocked by security policies. I'm working on finding an alternative way to get these files to you.

Could you please confirm if you have access to these links, or would you prefer me to try a different approach?

Best regards,
Emma
args.subject: Re: Resume Template Request
